signs.c: Aries starts things. Fast, honest and competitive, it learns by doing and gets bored by waiting.
Taurus builds and keeps. Patient, practical and pleasure-loving, it values security and moves at its own pace.
Gemini connects. Quick, curious and social, it collects ideas and people and needs variety to stay engaged.
Cancer protects. Sensitive, intuitive and family-minded, it creates safety for itself and others.
Leo shines. Warm, creative and proud, it wants to be seen and is generous with its heart.
Virgo refines. Analytical, helpful and precise, it improves whatever it touches.
Libra balances. Diplomatic, aesthetic and relationship-oriented, it looks for harmony and fairness.
Scorpio transforms. Deep, private and determined, it wants the truth beneath the surface.
Sagittarius explores. Optimistic, restless and philosophical, it looks for meaning and freedom.
Capricorn achieves. Disciplined, strategic and patient, it plays the long game.
Aquarius innovates. Original, humane and a little detached, it thinks about the future and the group.
Pisces dissolves boundaries. Intuitive, compassionate and artistic, it feels everything around it.

animals.t: Quick, resourceful and alert to opportunity.
Steady and patient; you build things that last.
Bold and protective, drawn to a challenge.
Diplomatic and tasteful; you look for calm.
Ambitious and magnetic; you think big.
Energetic and independent; you need movement.
Clever and inventive; you adapt quickly.
Precise and honest, with high standards.
Loyal and fair, protective of your people.
Generous and warm; you enjoy the good things.
